column2: Full SoC MNIST Handwritten Digit Recognition Pipeline (Core + All IPs)
column3:
Internal & External Data Path
(Internal: Core <-> Interconnect <-> DMEM, CNN, ReLU, Pooling, Timer; External: UART TX/RX, GPIO LEDs, 7-Seg)
column4:
Complete end-to-end bare-metal firmware (mnist_inference.c) executing full MNIST digit recognition pipeline on VeeR EL2 core with all hardware accelerators:
1. Initializes UART (8N1, baud div 50), GPIO (LEDs out), 7-Segment (D0 enable, fast_sim), ReLU, and Pooling.
2. Programs trained CNN 3x3 filter weights (0x18..0x38) and bias (0x3C).
3. Starts performance hardware Timer (TIMER_LOAD = 0x0FFFFFFF).
4. Streams 28x28 grayscale sample image through 13x13 pooling regions: 3x3 receptive fields loaded into CNN accelerator, hardware convolution result piped into hardware ReLU unit, 2x2 activations loaded into hardware Pooling unit -> produces 169 pooled features in DMEM.
5. VeeR EL2 executes Fully-Connected (FC) software classifier (10 classes x 169 weights + biases) to compute class logits and argmax predicted digit.
6. Outputs recognized digit to 7-Segment Display Controller.
7. Prints predicted digit, expected digit, and elapsed cycle count to UART.
8. Asserts GPIO LEDs (0x00AA on pass, 0x00FF on fail) and writes DMEM_PASS_FLAG = 1.

• Core boots from ICCM (0xEE00_0000) and orchestrates all 9 slave peripherals over AXI crossbar
• CNN + ReLU + Pooling hardware acceleration executes without bus hang or starvation
• Software FC classification calculates predicted digit (e.g., Digit '7')
• Predicted digit matches EXPECTED_DIGIT (predicted == 7)
• Seven-Segment display shows predicted digit on physical/simulated display
• UART terminal receives ASCII report with digit and execution cycle benchmark
• GPIO LEDs output 0x00AA (PASS pattern)
• DMEM_PASS_FLAG (0x1000_0014) written with 1; testbench declares simulation PASS
